sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日新闻简报《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些未经修饰、直言不讳的对话实况。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: This is my primal scream.
sentences.zh: 这是我的原始呐喊。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·

sentences.en: Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say.
sentences.zh: 我只是想说。

sentences.en: Several months ago, the Times opened up a phone line to ask Americans what it's really been like to parent during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，《纽约时报》开通了一条电话热线，询问美国人在疫情期间为人父母的真实感受。

sentences.en: I have to hide in my closet to make this phone call because there's no peace.
sentences.zh: 我得躲在衣柜里打这个电话，因为根本没有片刻安宁。

sentences.en: There's no quiet.
sentences.zh: 没有安静。

sentences.en: All I hear all the time is mom.
sentences.zh: 我一直听到的就是妈妈。

sentences.en: Like that.
sentences.zh: 就像那样。

sentences.en: They're coming to get me.
sentences.zh: 他们要来抓我了。

sentences.en: I can't escape these kids.
sentences.zh: 我无法逃离这些孩子。

sentences.en: They eat all day long.
sentences.zh: 他们整天都在吃。

sentences.en: There is way more laundry than when they were in school.
sentences.zh: 洗的衣服比他们上学时多多了。

sentences.en: And all their pets, I have their dog, and I've got the three-legged hedgehog, and I've got the talking parrot, and no one wants to feed them.
sentences.zh: 还有他们的宠物，我有他们的狗，还有三条腿的刺猬，还有会说话的鹦鹉，可没人想喂它们。

sentences.en: I think I need to run away.
sentences.zh: 我想我需要离家出走。

sentences.en: All I can do is hide in this closet.
sentences.zh: 我唯一能做的就是躲在这个衣柜里。

sentences.en: And even this doesn't last long enough.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，也持续不了多久。

sentences.en: Mom.
sentences.zh: 妈妈。

sentences.en: I have to go.
sentences.zh: 我得走了。

sentences.en: I'm being called.
sentences.zh: 有人在叫我。

sentences.en: Mom.
sentences.zh: 妈妈。

sentences.en: One more scream.
sentences.zh: 再喊一声。

sentences.en: Hello, New York Times.
sentences.zh: 你好，《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: I'm calling you from the toilet because I literally just had to say to my kids, I'm going to pee.
sentences.zh: 我是在厕所里给你打电话的，因为我刚才真的不得不对孩子们说，我要去尿尿。

sentences.en: Leave me alone.
sentences.zh: 别打扰我。

sentences.en: My child just cleaned our faces with toilet water.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子刚刚用马桶水洗了我们的脸。

sentences.en: I miss being able to crap in peace.
sentences.zh: 我怀念能安安静静拉屎的日子。

sentences.en: I am sitting right now in the toilet, and my 13-month-old daughter is running around.
sentences.zh: 我现在正坐在马桶上，我13个月大的女儿在周围跑来跑去。

sentences.en: Yep, now she's in the bathroom, and she's going to try and steal the toilet paper.
sentences.zh: 没错，现在她进了浴室，正打算去偷卫生纸。

sentences.en: Oh, I should add that I'm a single mother, so this is every day.
sentences.zh: 哦，我应该补充一下，我是个单亲妈妈，所以这就是我的每一天。

sentences.en: There's no partners.
sentences.zh: 没有伴侣。

sentences.en: I mean, my mom is here, but she don't know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我妈在这儿，但她不懂。

sentences.en: She'll quote-unquote watch the baby, but then I find the baby eating, like, lint out of the garbage cans.
sentences.zh: 她会所谓的“看孩子”，但后来我发现孩子在吃垃圾桶里的棉絮之类的东西。

sentences.en: The upstairs pillows are downstairs.
sentences.zh: 楼上的枕头在楼下。

sentences.en: The downstairs pillows are upstairs, and I didn't think that upstairs pillows being downstairs and downstairs
sentences.zh: 楼下的枕头在楼上，我没想到楼上的枕头在楼下、楼下的

sentences.en: pillows being upstairs would bring me this level of anxiety, but here we are.
sentences.zh: 枕头在楼上会给我带来这种程度的焦虑，但事实就是这样。

sentences.en: I love my kids, but for fuck's sake, like, we are together all of the time.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的孩子，但去他妈的，我们真的无时无刻不在一起。

sentences.en: Somebody else.
sentences.zh: 换个人吧。

sentences.en: We are my children.
sentences.zh: 我们是我的孩子。

sentences.en: We...
sentences.zh: 我们……

sentences.en: My kids are assholes.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子是混蛋。

sentences.en: They are primates.
sentences.zh: 他们是灵长类动物。

sentences.en: They're barely human.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎不算人类。

sentences.en: They think I'm a slave.
sentences.zh: 他们以为我是奴隶。

sentences.en: They're so messy.
sentences.zh: 他们太邋遢了。

sentences.en: The cleaning and the cooking, that's the hardest part.
sentences.zh: 打扫和做饭，那是最难的部分。

sentences.en: They just eat all the time and make messes.
sentences.zh: 他们总是吃个不停，还弄得一团糟。

sentences.en: They don't even care.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不在乎。

sentences.en: They'll just look at you and throw something on the floor.
sentences.zh: 他们只会看着你，然后把东西扔在地板上。

sentences.en: I can't believe there's so many people on earth when it's this hard.
sentences.zh: 我真不敢相信，生活这么艰难，地球上竟然还有这么多人。

sentences.en: Sex is not that good, and I didn't even have sex.
sentences.zh: 性生活没那么好，而且我甚至没做过爱。

sentences.en: I did do IVF.
sentences.zh: 我确实做了试管婴儿。

sentences.en: I just am amazed that...
sentences.zh: 我只是惊讶于……

sentences.en: Friday, April 16th.
sentences.zh: 4月16日，星期五。

sentences.en: It's the morning.
sentences.zh: 早上了。

sentences.en: We're up and ready to go almoSt. I'm making French toast for Max, and I have to drink coffee, of course.
sentences.zh: 我们起床了，差不多准备好了。我在给马克斯做法式吐司，当然，我得喝咖啡。

sentences.en: My name's Elizabeth Halfhill.
sentences.zh: 我叫伊丽莎白·哈夫希尔。

sentences.en: I live in Spokane, Washington.
sentences.zh: 我住在华盛顿州斯波坎市。

sentences.en: I'm a full-time family law paralegal and a single mother of an 11-year-old kid named Max.
sentences.zh: 我是一名全职家庭法律律师助理，也是一个名叫马克斯的11岁孩子的单亲妈妈。

sentences.en: Say hi.
sentences.zh: 打个招呼。

sentences.en: Hello, New York Times News.
sentences.zh: 你好，《纽约时报》新闻。

sentences.en: My name is Max Snokes.
sentences.zh: 我叫马克斯·斯诺克斯。

sentences.en: I'm 11 years old.
sentences.zh: 我11岁。

sentences.en: My mom is
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是

sentences.en: Elizabeth Halfhill.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·哈夫希尔。

sentences.en: She's 30 years old.
sentences.zh: 她30岁。

sentences.en: Max is very kind.
sentences.zh: 马克斯非常善良。

sentences.en: He is very creative, so I just had to tell him to stop sawing cardboard in the background because he's building something right now while I do this.
sentences.zh: 他很有创造力，所以我刚才不得不叫他停止在背景里锯纸板，因为我在做这个的时候他正在造东西。

sentences.en: I like drawing, building Legos, a lot of forms of art, mainly clay and drawing.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢画画、搭乐高，很多艺术形式，主要是粘土和绘画。

sentences.en: Sometimes I do a little painting.
sentences.zh: 有时候我也会画点油画。

sentences.en: So he's creative.
sentences.zh: 所以他很有创造力。

sentences.en: He's kind.
sentences.zh: 他很善良。

sentences.en: He's really funny.
sentences.zh: 他真的很幽默。

sentences.en: He makes me laugh all of the time.
sentences.zh: 他总是让我发笑。

sentences.en: I mean, I just, even if he wasn't my kid, I love him as a person.
sentences.zh: 我是说，即使他不是我的孩子，我也会作为一个独立的人去爱他。

sentences.en: I have a drawing of a squirrel that I made.
sentences.zh: 我有一幅我画的松鼠画。

sentences.en: You have other ones, too.
sentences.zh: 你还有其他的，对吧。

sentences.en: I'll grab one.
sentences.zh: 我去拿一张。

sentences.en: No, no, mom.
sentences.zh: 不，不，妈妈。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 要的，要的，要的，要的。

sentences.en: Those are just doodles.
sentences.zh: 那些只是涂鸦。

sentences.en: Stop.
sentences.zh: 停下。

sentences.en: The weekend of March 13th, I remember March 13th was the date that everything, like, the state of emergency came down.
sentences.zh: 3月13日那个周末，我记得3月13日是所有事情，比如紧急状态发布的那一天。

sentences.en: It almost felt, I don't want to say fun, but, like, exciting.
sentences.zh: 感觉几乎，我不想说是有趣，但像是，令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Like, oh, school's out for two weeks, and, you know, then we get two weeks off, and it'll all go back to normal.
sentences.zh: 就像，哦，学校放假两周，你知道，然后我们有两周假期，一切都会恢复正常。

sentences.en: And so that was the first moment.
sentences.zh: 所以那是第一个时刻。

sentences.en: But the next moment was when I had made it through the summer with, you know, almost no child care and still having to work and all these things,
sentences.zh: 但下一个时刻是当我熬过夏天，你知道，几乎没有托儿服务，还得工作，所有这些事情，

sentences.en: and then the school announces two weeks before they were supposed to be back in session that no one would come back in person.
sentences.zh: 然后学校在开学前两周宣布没有人会返校上课。

sentences.en: And I don't know if it was a news article or a friend texted me, but I was sitting at home, and I just started bawling.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是一篇新闻报道还是朋友给我发了短信，但我当时坐在家里，就开始嚎啕大哭。

sentences.en: So closing thoughts at the end of the day before school.
sentences.zh: 所以，开学前一天的结束语。

sentences.en: Max and I cleaned up the whole house and made it nice for tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 马克斯和我打扫了整个房子，为明天做好了准备。

sentences.en: We got his laptop all logged in and updated so that hopefully it's smooth sailing in the morning with no, like, tech difficulties or anything.
sentences.zh: 我们把他的笔记本电脑登录好并更新了，希望明天早上能顺利进行，不会出现技术故障之类的。

sentences.en: Max told me that he isn't excited for this year at all, and he's just sad that he can't see his friends.
sentences.zh: 马克斯告诉我他一点也不期待今年，他只是很难过不能见到朋友。

sentences.en: He's really bummed out, which makes me worry because I feel like tomorrow's going to set the tone for the rest of the school year, and I just hope that he likes it somewhat.
sentences.zh: 他真的很沮丧，这让我很担心，因为我觉得明天会为整个学年定下基调，我只希望他能稍微喜欢一点。

sentences.en: I will check in in the morning when we wake up and kind of let you know how it's going throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 明天早上我们醒来时我会查看一下，并让你知道这一天过得怎么样。

sentences.en: Wish us luck.
sentences.zh: 祝我们好运。

sentences.en: This is our first day of school style.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的开学第一天风格。

sentences.en: Because there is only digital school now, so I don't really care.
sentences.zh: 因为现在只有数字学校，所以我真的不在乎。

sentences.en: It's black t-shirt and gym shorts.
sentences.zh: 黑色T恤和运动短裤。

sentences.en: Don't have to be too formal.
sentences.zh: 不需要太正式。

sentences.en: Okay, I left Max in his class.
sentences.zh: 好了，我把马克斯留在他的课堂里了。

sentences.en: He did okay for a minute, but his microphone on his freaking headset I just bought isn't working.
sentences.zh: 他表现得还行，但他那副我刚买的该死的耳机麦克风坏了。

sentences.en: It's 11 28 a.m.
sentences.zh: 现在是上午11点28分。

sentences.en: Max was out in the dining room muttering that he doesn't like school or his teacher because he was being silly on webcam, and they made him turn his camera off.
sentences.zh: 马克斯在餐厅里嘟囔说他不喜欢学校也不喜欢老师，因为他在摄像头前调皮，他们让他关掉摄像头。

sentences.en: I'm already really discouraged because I know that this is just going to turn into a power struggle where I tell Max to not be silly on camera and pay attention, and he is going
sentences.zh: 我已经很气馁了，因为我知道这只会变成一场权力斗争，我会告诉马克斯不要在镜头前调皮，要专心听讲，而他会

sentences.en: to get in trouble all year long because there's no peer pressure to be good.
sentences.zh: 整年都在惹麻烦，因为没有同伴压力让他表现良好。

sentences.en: It's literally just an adult and a kid and us one-on-one.
sentences.zh: 这真的只是一个大人和一个孩子，我们一对一。
现在是11点57分。

sentences.en: I'm making grilled cheese.
sentences.zh: 我在做烤奶酪三明治。

sentences.en: Max has informed me that his teacher has decided to call it quits for the entire day three hours early because everyone's just getting used to everything.
sentences.zh: 马克斯通知我，他的老师决定提前三个小时结束全天的课程，因为大家都在适应这一切。

sentences.en: Max says distance learning sex, and he doesn't want to do it, and I agree.
sentences.zh: 马克斯说远程学习烂透了，他不想做，我也同意。

sentences.en: So we're just going to take it day at a time and do the best we can.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只能走一步看一步，尽我们所能。

sentences.en: I got pregnant at 18, and Max was born when I was—I turned 19 right after he was born, actually.
sentences.zh: 我18岁时怀孕了，马克斯出生时我——其实他出生后我刚满19岁。

sentences.en: So I gave birth to him when I was 18.
sentences.zh: 所以我18岁时生下了他。

sentences.en: I was homeschooled by my parents religiously until fourth grade, like actual religious curriculum, and then I went to public school from that point on, and I ended up
sentences.zh: 我父母一直对我进行宗教家庭教育直到四年级，就是那种真正的宗教课程，从那以后我就上了公立学校，最后我在

sentences.en: dropping out of high school in my sophomore year and getting my GED.
sentences.zh: 高二时退学并拿到了同等学力证书（GED）。

sentences.en: Max's father and I were not married until he was three years old, but we did get married when he was three, and then we divorced when he was, I think, six.
sentences.zh: 马克斯的父亲和我直到他三岁才结婚，但他在三岁时我们确实结婚了，后来在他大概六岁时我们离婚了。

sentences.en: He was actually in jail from the time Max was six months old, so he missed, you know, a lot of the first holidays.
sentences.zh: 他其实在马克斯六个月大时就入狱了，所以他错过了很多第一个节日。

sentences.en: He—we were together after that, but I embodied a lot of the, you know, old-fashioned ideals of the mother doing most of the parenting, you know, and I worked, two.
sentences.zh: 他——在那之后我们在一起过，但我体现了很多那种老派的理想，即母亲承担大部分育儿责任，你知道，而且我也工作。

sentences.en: I worked full-time, so yeah.
sentences.zh: 我全职工作，所以是的。

sentences.en: Okay, so update.
sentences.zh: 好了，更新一下。

sentences.en: We're basically just by Thursday,
sentences.zh: 基本上到了周四、

sentences.en: Friday, we're at the end of our rope.
sentences.zh: 周五，我们已经精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: We've been on computers doing our work in our school for like four days, and we're tired.
sentences.zh: 我们已经在电脑前做工作和上学大概四天了，我们很累。

sentences.en: So we both woke up not in the mood today.
sentences.zh: 所以我们今天醒来时心情都不好。

sentences.en: Max wasn't paying close enough attention in class, and he sort of got snipped at by his teacher.
sentences.zh: 马克斯上课不够专心，被老师训斥了几句。

sentences.en: Max was playing a game on his phone during class time.
sentences.zh: 马克斯在上课时用手机玩游戏。

sentences.en: I got a little upset with him.
sentences.zh: 我对他有点生气。

sentences.en: And he immediately got a stress headache after that because he's just so stressed out by virtual school.
sentences.zh: 之后他立刻就出现了压力性头痛，因为虚拟学校让他压力太大了。

sentences.en: He feels like it's hard to pay attention.
sentences.zh: 他觉得很难集中注意力。

sentences.en: It's hard to get assignments done.
sentences.zh: 很难完成作业。

sentences.en: It's hard to understand what the teacher is saying when he's speaking to everyone in his Zoom meeting.
sentences.zh: 当老师在Zoom会议上对所有人讲话时，很难听懂他在说什么。

sentences.en: So he got a stress headache.
sentences.zh: 所以他头痛了。

sentences.en: He said he felt like he was going to throw up.
sentences.zh: 他说他感觉想吐。

sentences.en: He was like crying.
sentences.zh: 他在哭。

sentences.en: The stress is just a lot for him.
sentences.zh: 这种压力对他来说太大了。

sentences.en: I kind of go back and forth between knowing I need to be upset that he, you know, is not paying attention or this or that, and then having total empathy.
sentences.zh: 我一直在纠结，一方面知道我需要因为他没专心听讲而生气，另一方面又对他充满同情。

sentences.en: Like if I had to be on a Zoom meeting for five hours, I would definitely mess around on my phone too, right?
sentences.zh: 如果我必须参加五个小时的Zoom会议，我肯定也会忍不住玩手机，对吧？

sentences.en: So it's trying to find the line between enforcing the right boundary and also letting him know that I understand it's a struggle.
sentences.zh: 所以，我得在坚持原则和让他知道我理解他的挣扎之间找到平衡。

sentences.en: So I calmed him down and I made him like a bowl of cereal and a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 所以我安抚了他，给他做了碗麦片，泡了杯茶。

sentences.en: And I was like, I love you.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，我爱你。

sentences.en: I was like, this year, like, you're not going to fail.
sentences.zh: 我说，今年，你不会挂科的。

sentences.en: They won't hold you back.
sentences.zh: 他们不会留你的级的。

sentences.en: Like, you don't have to do perfect this year.
sentences.zh: 你今年不需要做到完美。

sentences.en: You just have to make it through and just be present in class as much as you can.
sentences.zh: 你只需要坚持下去，尽可能多地参与课堂就行了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So he felt better.
sentences.zh: 他感觉好多了。

sentences.en: There are days where he didn't want to pay any attention to his laptop class.
sentences.zh: 有些日子他根本不想理会笔记本电脑上的网课。

sentences.en: And it's hard to enforce that sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时候要强迫他确实很难。

sentences.en: I had just gotten divorced and I had a pretty good job working for Apple, but I knew I needed something long-term career wise.
sentences.zh: 我刚离婚，在苹果公司有一份相当不错的工作，但我知道我需要一份长期的职业规划。

sentences.en: And I, I didn't even know what I wanted to do, but I was like, you have to get back into college.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道自己想做什么，但我对自己说，你必须回到大学去。

sentences.en: You have to get a degree.
sentences.zh: 你必须拿到学位。

sentences.en: You have to do something.
sentences.zh: 你必须做点什么。

sentences.en: So I just enrolled at the local Spokane
sentences.zh: 所以我报名参加了当地的斯波坎

sentences.en: Community College.
sentences.zh: 社区学院。

sentences.en: And right around that time, I started working as a legal assistant part-time as well for the attorney that sort of got me started on the path.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我开始为那位引导我走上这条路的律师做兼职法律助理。

sentences.en: And she was telling me about the paralegal program, which was at the same college I was attending.
sentences.zh: 她告诉了我关于律师助理项目的事，正好就在我上的那所学院。

sentences.en: And so I just enrolled in the program and sort of took it from there, I guess.
sentences.zh: 于是我就报名参加了这个项目，我想，之后的事就顺其自然了。

sentences.en: Just finished my class.
sentences.zh: 刚上完课。

sentences.en: Um, and I was working the whole time, like typing emails for my job, but I'm going to go make a cup of coffee and then get to work for the day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我一直在工作，比如在工作中打打邮件，但我打算去冲杯咖啡，然后开始一天的工作。

sentences.en: Woo.
sentences.zh: 呜。

sentences.en: It's 9 17 AM.
sentences.zh: 现在是早上9点17分。

sentences.en: I'm still going to school.
sentences.zh: 我还在上学。

sentences.en: So I am always tired, like 100% of the time.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是很累，百分之百的时间都觉得累。

sentences.en: I did my class at work.
sentences.zh: 我在工作时上了课。

sentences.en: The receptionist held my calls.
sentences.zh: 前台帮我接听了电话。

sentences.en: Everyone's really nice about me being in school.
sentences.zh: 大家对我还在上学这件事都非常体谅。

sentences.en: So I returned all of those.
sentences.zh: 所以我把那些电话都回了。

sentences.en: And then I just had a really busy whirlwind day at work.
sentences.zh: 然后我在工作中度过了忙碌而混乱的一天。

sentences.en: Then we came home, rushed through a dinner, kept cleaning.
sentences.zh: 接着我们回到家，匆匆吃了晚饭，又接着打扫卫生。

sentences.en: I literally cleaned until like 8 30 PM and then took a bath.
sentences.zh: 我真的打扫到了晚上8点半，然后洗了个澡。

sentences.en: I am sitting now, but it is 9 58 PM and I'm doing my math homework.
sentences.zh: 我现在坐着，但已经是晚上9点58分了，我还在做数学作业。

sentences.en: So yeah, some days feel like they're so busy.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，有些日子感觉忙得不可开交。

sentences.en: They feel like they don't even exiSt. It's like, I just went through 24 hours and I don't even like remember any of it because I was just go, go, go, move, move, move.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像这些日子根本不存在一样。就像我刚度过了24小时，但我甚至记不起任何细节，因为我一直在奔波、忙碌、不停地动。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: When you download the New York times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free a month to go behind the paywall to see what time subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的，你可以越过付费墙，看看订阅者每天都能看到什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York times, download the times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I would like to let it be known for the record that I am not a homeschooler.
sentences.zh: 我想郑重声明，我不是那种在家教育孩子的人。

sentences.en: I never wanted to homeschool.
sentences.zh: 我从来没想过要在家里教育孩子。

sentences.en: I always put my kid in school.
sentences.zh: 我总是把孩子送到学校。

sentences.en: This isn't me.
sentences.zh: 这不适合我。

sentences.en: It ain't me.
sentences.zh: 真的不适合我。

sentences.en: I'm doing my best, but this is not my fricking talent.
sentences.zh: 我在尽力而为，但这真不是我的天赋所在。

sentences.en: This is not my talent space.
sentences.zh: 这不是我擅长的领域。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Not me.
sentences.zh: 不适合我。

sentences.en: I'm a great mom and I'm good at momming, but I'm not good at educating.
sentences.zh: 我是一个好妈妈，我很擅长当妈妈，但我并不擅长教育。

sentences.en: When they say tomorrow is a new day in COVID land, it's not a new day.
sentences.zh: 当他们说在疫情期间明天又是新的一天时，其实并不是。

sentences.en: And if it is a new day, it's probably just getting worse.
sentences.zh: 如果这真是新的一天，那情况可能只会变得更糟。

sentences.en: I'm actually just really pissed and upset because I know this isn't going to work all year.
sentences.zh: 我其实真的很生气，也很沮丧，因为我知道这样撑不了一整年。

sentences.en: I know he's not going to learn anything and he's just going to be sitting at a fricking computer screen.
sentences.zh: 我知道他学不到任何东西，只会整天坐在该死的电脑屏幕前。

sentences.en: Like I wish they'd just cancel school for the year.
sentences.zh: 我真希望他们今年干脆取消学校课程算了。

sentences.en: There's no point.
sentences.zh: 根本没意义。

sentences.en: It's like you're implementing the system that just isn't going to work for most kids and they're all going to be really behind anyways.
sentences.zh: 这就像是在推行一套对大多数孩子根本行不通的系统，反正他们最后都会落后很多。

sentences.en: So why don't they just let us parents figure out what we're going to do during the day on our own and take them to childcare or whatever and just can it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们为什么不让我们家长自己决定白天该做什么，把孩子送到托儿所之类的，然后干脆停课呢？

sentences.en: Like we're expected to keep working and implement an entire education system at home and have this power struggle of making them log into meetings at certain times,
sentences.zh: 我们被要求继续工作，同时在家里实施一套完整的教育系统，还要为了让他们准时登录会议而进行权力斗争，

sentences.en: five days a week.
sentences.zh: 每周五天。

sentences.en: It's not realistic and it's not doable.
sentences.zh: 这既不现实，也做不到。

sentences.en: And I might be really upset because this is drawing on like a bigger thing that I already deal with where I'm not a married parent.
sentences.zh: 我可能真的很沮丧，因为这触及了我已经在处理的一个更大的问题，那就是我不是已婚家长。

sentences.en: I'm not stay at home.
sentences.zh: 我不是全职妈妈。

sentences.en: I don't have a stay at home spouse.
sentences.zh: 我也没有全职在家的配偶。

sentences.en: It's harder for me to do things already for max working full time, like sports or extracurricular activities or things that I can't afford anyways.
sentences.zh: 对于全职工作的我来说，做些事情已经很难了，比如体育运动、课外活动，或者我本来就负担不起的事情。

sentences.en: And then on top of it now, like the pandemic hit and it just exasperates on like, I'm going to cry, but like things I already deal with and stress,
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，现在疫情爆发了，这只会加剧——我要哭了——我本来就在处理的压力，

sentences.en: like not being able to do things and provide as much for him as a lot of other families do.
sentences.zh: 比如无法像许多其他家庭那样为他提供支持和参与活动。

sentences.en: And the pressure's now triple on me.
sentences.zh: 现在我身上的压力是原来的三倍。

sentences.en: Not that it's not on other parents too, but like, it's kind of impossible for me to make this work because I'm not like your classic design of a family that
sentences.zh: 并不是说其他家长没有压力，但对我来说，要让这一切运转起来几乎是不可能的，因为我不是那种典型的家庭结构，

sentences.en: is prepared for something like this.
sentences.zh: 能为这样的事情做好准备。

sentences.en: I depend heavily on social things like school to get me by.
sentences.zh: 我非常依赖学校这样的社会资源来维持生活。

sentences.en: And then without it, I don't know what I'm supposed to do.
sentences.zh: 没有了它，我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: So I'm a single mom in the pandemic and I'm a teacher.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是一个疫情期间的单亲妈妈，也是一名教师。

sentences.en: So I feel like single mothers and teachers and mothers in general all take on more than they can.
sentences.zh: 我觉得单亲妈妈、教师以及所有的母亲，承担的都比她们能承受的多。

sentences.en: And so I have like three strikes against me.
sentences.zh: 所以我面临着三重打击。

sentences.en: And it's just impossible.
sentences.zh: 这简直是不可能的。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm not doing anything well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我什么都没做好。

sentences.en: I feel like everything I do, I do badly because I'm managing so many people and so many things.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我做的每一件事都很糟糕，因为我要管理的人和事太多了。

sentences.en: I'm wondering if I missed the delivery of the toolbox that was delivered when this shit all went down last year.
sentences.zh: 我在想，去年这一切烂摊子开始时，我是不是错过了那个工具箱的派送。

sentences.en: I'm trying to be a good professional woman and a good mom all at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我正努力同时做一个好的职业女性和一个好妈妈。

sentences.en: And no one is telling me how to do this.
sentences.zh: 没有人告诉我该怎么做。

sentences.en: I'm not expecting handouts.
sentences.zh: 我不指望施舍。

sentences.en: I don't expect things to be easy, but I just want it to be doable.
sentences.zh: 我不指望事情会变得容易，但我只希望它是可行的。

sentences.en: My daughter is three years old.
sentences.zh: 我女儿三岁了。

sentences.en: And eight days ago, I gave birth to a stillborn baby at 21 weeks of gestation.
sentences.zh: 八天前，我在怀孕21周时生下了一个死胎。

sentences.en: Today is my three-year-old's last day of preschool for the year.
sentences.zh: 今天是我的三岁孩子今年幼儿园的最后一天。

sentences.en: And I don't know how I'm going to make it to the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我该怎么撑到年底。

sentences.en: I can barely take care of myself.
sentences.zh: 我连照顾自己都勉强。

sentences.en: No happiness in my life.
sentences.zh: 我的生活中没有快乐。

sentences.en: I can't stand my kids anymore.
sentences.zh: 我再也无法忍受我的孩子们了。

sentences.en: I'm just miserable.
sentences.zh: 我简直痛苦不堪。

sentences.en: I am rarely alone.
sentences.zh: 我很少有独处的时间。

sentences.en: Even when I go in my room at night to go to sleep and turn out the light, somebody comes in to talk to me and tell me another thing.
sentences.zh: 即使晚上我回房间睡觉关上灯，也会有人进来跟我说话，告诉我另一件事。

sentences.en: It's endless.
sentences.zh: 没完没了。

sentences.en: I'm lucky I haven't lost my job yet.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运还没丢掉工作。

sentences.en: I'm on the phone with clients all day.
sentences.zh: 我整天都在和客户通电话。

sentences.en: And I have a five-year-old in the background.
sentences.zh: 而背景里还有一个五岁的孩子。

sentences.en: But if he's hurt on there, I could lose my job.
sentences.zh: 如果他在那儿受伤了，我可能会丢掉工作。

sentences.en: I'm not only source of income and we could be homeless.
sentences.zh: 我是唯一的收入来源，我们可能会流落街头。

sentences.en: How are we going to do this?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么熬过去？

sentences.en: I'm so angry at our entire government and societal system.
sentences.zh: 我对我们整个政府和社会体系感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: There's just no backup or no help or nothing.
sentences.zh: 根本没有任何后援、帮助或支持。

sentences.en: I just want to wake up and go through my day and not worry and not wonder and not know what the future holds because this right here sucks and I'm sick of it.
sentences.zh: 我只想醒来，过完我的一天，不用担心，不用猜疑，不用去想未来会怎样，因为现在这一切糟透了，我受够了。

sentences.en: I'm so of this.
sentences.zh: 我真的受够了。

sentences.en: This pandemic has made me realize that maybe I'm not cut out to be a mother.
sentences.zh: 这场疫情让我意识到，也许我根本不适合当母亲。

sentences.en: I love my kids, but I don't like being a mom.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的孩子，但我不喜欢当妈妈。

sentences.en: And I don't like being a mom in America because it's just so much more clear that America hates women and hates families.
sentences.zh: 而且我不喜欢在美国当妈妈，因为这更清楚地表明美国讨厌女性，讨厌家庭。

sentences.en: We don't have support.
sentences.zh: 我们没有支持。

sentences.en: Moms are not heroes.
sentences.zh: 妈妈们不是英雄。

sentences.en: And this is just so hard.
sentences.zh: 这真的太难了。

sentences.en: So hard.
sentences.zh: 太难了。

sentences.en: Just eating breakfast, getting ready for the day.
sentences.zh: 刚吃完早餐，准备开始新的一天。

sentences.en: It's about 7.45 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 现在大约是早上7点45分。

sentences.en: Max had cream of wheat and toast and I had toast and coffee.
sentences.zh: Max吃了麦片粥和吐司，我吃了吐司和咖啡。

sentences.en: And we'll be leaving here in like a half hour to drop him at Susan's.
sentences.zh: 我们半小时后就要出发，把他送到苏珊家。

sentences.en: How are you doing, Max?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样，Max？

sentences.en: He says thumbs up.
sentences.zh: 他竖起了大拇指。

sentences.en: Susan is a very dear friend and I would venture to say sort of chosen family style friend.
sentences.zh: 苏珊是一位非常亲密的朋友，我甚至可以说她是那种“选择性家人”式的朋友。

sentences.en: Max and I, before we moved into the house we are in now, lived in a neighborhood where there were
sentences.zh: 在搬到现在的房子之前，Max和我住在一个街区，那里有

sentences.en: a lot of kids and a lot of parents living in a block radius and Susan was one of them.
sentences.zh: 很多孩子和很多家长，苏珊就是其中之一。

sentences.en: They all homeschooled prior to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 疫情前他们都在家教育孩子。

sentences.en: So they were already set for all of this, but all of our kids are best friends.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对这一切早有准备，而且我们的孩子都是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: They run all over the neighborhood together and Susan was home and she said, Max can
sentences.zh: 他们一起在街区里跑来跑去，苏珊当时在家，她说，Max可以

sentences.en: come and be on his laptop here while I teach my kids and then he can play with them in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 过来，在我教我孩子的时候用他的笔记本电脑，下午他可以和他们一起玩。

sentences.en: So she's a part of my essential community.
sentences.zh: 所以她是我的核心社区的一部分。

sentences.en: Like I could not have gotten through the pandemic without these other women in my neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 如果没有社区里的这些女性，我根本无法度过这场疫情。

sentences.en: So also just to update you on where we've been, last week was mostly fine.
sentences.zh: 另外，更新一下我们的近况，上周大部分时间还好。

sentences.en: Max is doing good being at Susan's because he has friends there, but he is already completely burnt out on laptop work.
sentences.zh: Max在苏珊家过得不错，因为他有朋友在那里，但他已经对笔记本电脑上的学习完全精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: It's been two weeks and he says that he just hates sitting in front of that webcam all day and it isn't fun because it's not like, you know,
sentences.zh: 已经两周了，他说他讨厌整天坐在摄像头前，这根本不好玩，因为你知道，

sentences.en: they'll have you do some things, but it's not interactive.
sentences.zh: 他们会让你做一些事情，但那不是互动式的。

sentences.en: There's no arts and crafts.
sentences.zh: 没有手工课。

sentences.en: There's no gym.
sentences.zh: 没有体育课。

sentences.en: There's no music.
sentences.zh: 没有音乐课。

sentences.en: Like there's nothing to do with your hands basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上没有什么需要动手做的事情。

sentences.en: So I texted his teacher on Monday and I said, listen, he just can't do this for the amount of time that you guys are expecting.
sentences.zh: 所以我周一给他的老师发了短信，我说，听着，他实在无法按照你们期望的时间长度来上课。

sentences.en: He's going to be done at noon every day.
sentences.zh: 他每天中午就会结束学习。

sentences.en: So this week he's only doing school from eight 30 to noon at lunchtime.
sentences.zh: 所以这周他只在上午8点半到中午这段时间上课。

sentences.en: Um, his homeschool friends are out of homeschool afternoon and he's been playing magic cards and walking to the park and doing things that I find to be better than
sentences.zh: 嗯，他那些在家教育的朋友下午不上课，他一直在玩魔法卡牌，去公园散步，做一些我觉得比

sentences.en: sitting on a screen for the afternoons.
sentences.zh: 下午盯着屏幕更好的事情。

sentences.en: And his teacher was totally understanding.
sentences.zh: 他的老师非常理解。

sentences.en: He wrote back and said, you know, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 他回信说，你知道，我很抱歉。

sentences.en: I, this totally sucks is what he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，这真是糟透了。

sentences.en: Um, he said there was no other way to say it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他说没法用其他话来形容了。

sentences.en: Can you come in here?
sentences.zh: 你能进来吗？

sentences.en: Also, you were supposed to take the dog out and you never did.
sentences.zh: 还有，你应该带狗出去的，但你从来没做过。

sentences.en: Well, look at him.
sentences.zh: 好吧，看看他。

sentences.en: He's sad.
sentences.zh: 他很难过。

sentences.en: Look at his face.
sentences.zh: 看看他的脸。

sentences.en: So I had Susan and then I ended up working from home from November through January.
sentences.zh: 所以，我有苏珊帮忙，后来我从11月到1月都在家工作。

sentences.en: And then I used Boys and Girls Club until he went back to school February 17th.
sentences.zh: 然后我让Max去了男孩女孩俱乐部，直到他2月17日回到学校上课。

sentences.en: And now he is back at school two, two days, one week, three days, the following week.
sentences.zh: 现在他回学校了，两天，一周，三天，接下来的一周。

sentences.en: And I have to find care the other few days.
sentences.zh: 我得找人照顾剩下的那几天。

sentences.en: I think we've gotten closer over this little while.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这段时间我们亲近了一些。

sentences.en: We get into arguments sometimes, but other than that, we're pretty close.
sentences.zh: 我们有时会吵架，但除此之外，我们关系挺好的。

sentences.en: You're going to make me cry.
sentences.zh: 你这是要让我哭啊。

sentences.en: All of the stresses that caused us to be annoyed with each other or anything like that were all outside stresses of the situation.
sentences.zh: 所有导致我们互相烦恼的压力，或者诸如此类的事情，都是源于外部环境的压力。

sentences.en: And we handled them.
sentences.zh: 而我们都应对过来了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I don't think it's changed at all.
sentences.zh: 我觉得一点都没变。

sentences.en: Really.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: It feels the same.
sentences.zh: 感觉还是一样。

sentences.en: We get along decently and we enjoy spending time with each other.
sentences.zh: 我们相处得不错，也喜欢待在一起。

sentences.en: It's like, it's like where we had a relationship beforehand and the situation around it shifted, but we're just mother and son, best buds.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我们之前就有那种关系，虽然周围的情况变了，但我们依然是母子，是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And it's still that way.
sentences.zh: 现在依然如此。

sentences.en: I think I was always this way, but I think I now realize I'm absolutely unstoppable.
sentences.zh: 我想我一直都是这样，但我现在意识到我绝对是不可阻挡的。

sentences.en: Just nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都阻挡不了。

sentences.en: I'm always going to figure out a way to make it work.
sentences.zh: 我总能找到办法解决问题。

sentences.en: I like nothing will stop me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得没有什么能阻止我。

sentences.en: Nothing can stop me from just keep on, keeping on, keeping on, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想，没有什么能阻止我继续前进，继续努力，一直走下去。

sentences.en: So today is April 14th and I made homemade pizza for dinner.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月14日，我做了自制披萨当晚餐。

sentences.en: Max, how would you rate today?
sentences.zh: 马克斯，你给今天打几分？

sentences.en: One to
sentences.zh: 一到
十分？

sentences.en: Eight.
sentences.zh: 八分。

sentences.en: And how come?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because it was a good day.
sentences.zh: 因为这是美好的一天。

sentences.en: I had fun with my friends.
sentences.zh: 我和朋友们玩得很开心。

sentences.en: I got scraped up a little bit, but other than that, it was awesome.
sentences.zh: 虽然受了点小擦伤，但除此之外，棒极了。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: Well, I rated an eight for you too.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也给你打八分。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And that's our report of a school day.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的上学日报告。

sentences.en: Later.
sentences.zh: 回见。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: Have you made a decision today, whether you intend to testify or whether you intend to invoke your fifth amendment privilege?
sentences.zh: 你今天做出决定了吗？你是打算作证，还是打算援引第五修正案赋予你的特权？

sentences.en: Uh, I will invoke my fifth amendment privilege today.
sentences.zh: 呃，我今天将援引第五修正案赋予我的特权。

sentences.en: On Thursday, Derek Chauvin declined to testify on his own behalf and his defense lawyers rested their case, ending the testimony phase of his murder trial
sentences.zh: 周四，德里克·肖万拒绝为自己辩护，他的辩护律师宣布结案，结束了他谋杀案审判的证词阶段，

sentences.en: in the death of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 即乔治·弗洛伊德死亡案。

sentences.en: Closing arguments will begin on Monday, after which the jury will begin deliberations.
sentences.zh: 结案陈词将于周一开始，之后陪审团将开始审议。

sentences.en: Uh, if I were you, I would plan for long and hope for short.
sentences.zh: 呃，如果我是你，我会做长期打算，但希望过程能短一些。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, the judge in the case, Peter Cahill, began preparing jurors for that process.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，该案法官彼得·卡希尔开始让陪审员为这一程序做准备。

sentences.en: Basically, it's up to the jury how long you deliberate, how long you need to come to a unanimous decision on any count.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你们审议多久，需要多久才能对任何指控达成一致裁决，都由陪审团决定。

sentences.en: And so because that's entirely up to you, whether it's an hour or a week, it's entirely within your province.
sentences.zh: 所以，因为这完全取决于你们，无论是一个小时还是一周，这完全在你们的职权范围内。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由迈克尔·西蒙制作，

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer,
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me,
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，和我一起，

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。
